blocks.path: What is high cholesterol? - High cholesterol
s: High cholesterol is when you have too much of a fatty substance called cholesterol in your blood.

blocks.path: What is high cholesterol? - High cholesterol
s: You're more likely to get high cholesterol if you're over 50, a man, you've been through the menopause, or you're of South Asian or sub-Saharan African origin.
It can also run in families.

blocks.path: What is high cholesterol? - High cholesterol
s: It can also be caused by eating fatty food, not exercising enough, being overweight, smoking and drinking alcohol.

blocks.path: What is high cholesterol? - High cholesterol
s: You can lower your cholesterol by eating healthily and getting more exercise.
Some people also need to take medicine.

blocks.path: What is high cholesterol? - High cholesterol
s: Too much cholesterol can block your blood vessels.
It makes you more likely to have heart problems or a stroke.

blocks.path: What is high cholesterol? - High cholesterol
s: High cholesterol does not usually cause symptoms.
You can only find out if you have it from a blood test.

blocks.path: What is high cholesterol? - High cholesterol
s: HEART UK has information about inherited high cholesterol that starts at a young age (familial hypercholesterolaemia).

blocks.path: What is high cholesterol? - High cholesterol
s: Find out about familial hypercholesterolaemia on the HEART UK website
